run.externalHostContention: not isolated or measured; other host activity cannot be ruled out

results.evidenceScope: portable Linux CPU callback simulation; no RtAudio device, no hardware acceptance
results.rssMetric: getrusage ru_maxrss high-water mark, KiB on Linux; includes loop store and runtime; not PSS

acceptance.functionalOutput: passed: all 12,800,000 output samples finite; 20/20 configured FX slots healthy
acceptance.callbackP99Deadline: P99 836205 ns is below 1333333 ns, but P99.9 2355160 ns exceeds deadline
acceptance.overallRealTimeAcceptance: not passed; 301/100000 callbacks exceeded 1.333 ms deadline
acceptance.hardwareAcceptance: not measured: this was portable Native callback CPU simulation without RtAudio/audio device

limitations: No real audio device, XRUN counter, output route, physical latency, thermal condition, or sound-quality panel was measured.
The workload had five synthetic 300-second stereo loop buffers (576,000,000 bytes total) at 48 kHz and 20 per-track FX slots; it did not fill the global input and shared legacy banks simultaneously.
ru_maxrss is a Linux process high-water metric and includes loop storage/runtime; the delta is not exact per-FX allocation and is not PSS.
The environment reports an AMD EPYC 9V74 host model but only 9 hardware-concurrency threads to the process; host isolation/CPU scheduling is not guaranteed.
